issue.title: Annotated reference overwrite on the Mac
issue.description: Annotated reference overwrite preserves old PDFs, assets, anchors, and reading-task identity through coordinated Mac transactions, rejects unsafe hosts, and protects scans and recovery from stale editor writes.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/annotated_reference_overwrite.md requests this work

issue.title: Plan annotated archives and selective highlight links
issue.description: archive: Extend the existing read-only overwrite plan with an annotated archive bundle, frozen metadata and assets, and highlight-only inbound link rewrites. Establish the shared archive metadata reader. Keep annotated execution refused until the execute phase.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/annotated_reference_overwrite.md defines phase archive as one work unit

issue.title: Hold scans that encounter a replaced annotated PDF
issue.description: guard: Use the archived PDF evidence to hold a restored old PDF before sync can import annotations, change tasks, or repair its marker. Cover human and JSON scan, explicit sync, dry-run behavior, and a race before execution; keep ordinary scans unchanged.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/annotated_reference_overwrite.md defines phase guard as one work unit

issue.title: Recover transactions that renamed annotated bundles
issue.description: recovery: Extend the host-local overwrite intent and recovery to describe no-clobber PDF and asset moves, reverse them safely on failure, and preserve unexpected late editor writes. Retain version-1 intent compatibility. Keep production annotated overwrite disabled; exercise recovery with synthetic interrupted transactions.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/annotated_reference_overwrite.md defines phase recovery as one work unit

issue.title: Enable coordinated annotated overwrite
issue.description: execute: Replace the annotated interim refusal with the Mac/config gate and consume the prepared archive, link, scan-guard, and recovery contracts in the existing transaction. Rename the PDF and assets under one bounded merging coordination, preserve reading-task identity, and verify or roll back the complete change. Add fake-coordinator transaction and hold tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/annotated_reference_overwrite.md defines phase execute as one work unit

issue.title: Verify user behavior and extend Mac acceptance documentation
issue.description: acceptance: Add cross-cutting recapture regressions, pin processed annotation identity, extend the isolated Highlights acceptance kit, and update create/sync docs. Run the prescribed local gates and prepare evidence for the child epic land agent. Real Highlights acceptance is a manual Mac step, never a Linux claim.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/annotated_reference_overwrite.md defines phase acceptance as one work unit

payload.entry: LANDER FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (bob-cli-c9.5.1.land): (1) bob-cli-c9.5.1.1 note #2 and (2) bob-cli-c9.5.1.3 note #1 (capture_related synthetic-vault perf gate flake) — declined as duplicates of bob-cli-ca, which 7b8c5ddb fixed (closed 2026-10-26T13:56Z); both observations predate that fix landing in the workers' trees and the landing just check on 8a1679e5 passed the full lib suite (3584 passed), so no +1/reopen. (3) Landing-discovered pre-existing CI failures (highlights_create_collection_overwrites_exact_set_with_listen pre-syncs default ~/bob; force_adopted_empty_target exit 1 vs 2) were introduced by bob-cli-c9.4.1.7 / c9.3.1.1, so per /sase_new_task they were recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note on active epic bob-cli-c9, not a task. (4) Parent phase bob-cli-c9.5 note #1 (missing recapture research reference) is not a child-of-this-epic proposal; it stays for the bob-cli-c9 land agent. (5) Review findings declined without filing: open-note-task embed exemption breadth (is_embed_task_line predates this epic in c9.4; narrowing could newly refuse legacy embeds and no walker harm was demonstrated); guard I/O error aborting a whole scan and repeated per-PDF archive hashing (speculative, low impact); Linux dry-run previewing an annotated archive (intended by acceptance tests); '0 highlights' wording for assets-only/inbound-only refusals (plan-prescribed text). Epic-caused defects found in review go to the landing tale.

LAND REVIEW (bob-cli-c9.5.1.land) at 92706cb4: Read epic plan, all 5 phases and notes, commits e4825208/564168f3/af416080/ca6065af/8a1679e5 and the code. just check on 8a1679e5 passed on athena (lib 3584, cli 2206). Outside commits since e4825208 (7b8c5ddb perf gate fix, 69dfd7e8/3633a10a stats, 01f7ec97 .bob walker exclusion, c7ced497 render-time code catalog, 92706cb4 completion) need no integration change; overwrite/source-store integration is owned by in-progress bob-cli-cc.5 (coordination note added there). Epic-symbols empty; no symvision recipe. Remaining epic-caused work blocks closing: (1) macOS CI red on ca6065af: /var->/private/var canonicalization (checked_vault_path canonical path stripped against non-canonical bob_dir) puts absolute .assets paths in intents and drops annotated assets; also non-cfg-gated key-on test and overwrite_web host-text asserts; (2) task_line_index/find_task_line match ^block_id by substring (^ref-x matches ^ref-x-v2); (3) recovery reverse rename coordinates the absent live path instead of the archive, falls back uncoordinated on config error, proves hashes outside the accessor, uses check-then-fs::rename, and fail-closed errors lack the required recovery hint; (4) frozen note/replacement PDF published non-atomically (partial write strands the intent); (5) earlier archives' PDFs/assets are in intent.touched and get git-checkout restored on rollback, discarding late saves; (6) ambiguous inbound #^h- links never reported and dangling ones fail verify after mutation; (7) docs list editor_active as overwrite hold, '1 highlights', link count includes self-links, frozen parent from ref_type, guard ignores digest if archived PDF missing, verbose scan omits execution-time holds, dead integrity_fingerprint check; (8) annotated failpoint sweep missing (AfterAssets never armed). Proposing a medium tale that fixes these and performs same-turn closeout of bob-cli-c9.5.1 and phase bob-cli-c9.5.
